title: Magical Girl Raising Project F2P Manga Spinoff Ends in 5th Volume
content:
The spinoff centers on Alma and Supinon, researchers in the land of magic, who head to "F City" to investigate reports of the existence of a magical girl with the power to "cancel death," and secure her if possible. But what they find in F City is beyond what they imagined.

Yuzuki debuted the manga on Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! Web in August 2016, and went on hiatus in October 2017. The manga resumed in February earlier this year. The manga inspired a stage play in February 2025.

Endō's Mahō Shōjo Ikusei Keikaku light novel series is set in a world where a social game called The Magical Girl Raising Project allows one in tens of thousands of people to be a "magical girl" — possessing extraordinary physical capabilities and looks, as well as special magical powers that set them apart from the rest of the human race. But one day, in a district containing 16 magical girls, the administration announces that it must halve the number of magical girls to solve the problem of magical energy. At first, the 16 magical girls race to collect more "magical candy" than their competitors, but the rules quickly become twisted, and it quickly becomes a murderous battle for survival among them. The series has inspierd sequels and spinoffs covering different aspects of the setting.

Endō launched the original light novel series through Takarajimasha 's Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! Bunko imprint in June 2012, and Takarajimasha published the 19th volume on October 2023. The second and third light novel volumes, published in November and December 2012, cover the "Restart" arc. Yen Press began publishing the novel series in English in June 2017.

Nori-Senbei launched the manga adaptation of the "Restart" arc in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comp Ace magazine in 2016, and Kadokawa published one volume in September 2016.

The first 12-episode Magical Girl Raising Project anime premiered in Japan on the AT-X channel in October 2016, and Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired.

The "Restart" arc is inspiring an ongoing television anime adaptation that debuted on October 5. OceanVeil is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Sho Yamazaki Launches New Manga with Fuyu Aoki
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket platform announced on Friday that Sho Yamazaki will launch a manga with writer Fuyu Aoki titled Shuran Reijō no Yarakashi: Seiryaku Kekkonmae Yakesake, Ki ga Tsuku to Reikokuna Konyakusha to Dragon no Hate no Naka (The Violent Drunken Noblewoman's Screw-up: Drowning in Alcohol Before My Political Marriage, I Then Awoke in The Middle of a Dragon's Den with My Cold-Hearted Fiancé) on the platform on October 30.

The story follows Arwina, whose extremely adorable younger sister Lorelai draws the attention of every young man. Just when Arwina finally makes a match who is seemingly immune to Lorelai, her fiancé calls off the marriage on the night of her 21st birthday. She heads to the bar to drink her feelings away in a drunken rampage, only to awaken the next day in bed with an unknown man.

Yamazaki launched the Taro Miyao Becomes A Cat Parent?! ( Miyaō Tarō ga Neko o Kau Nante ) manga on the Shonen Jump+ manga service in May 2024. Shueisha shipped the fourth compiled book volume in June 2025.

Yamazaki launched the Excuse me dentist, it's touching me! ( Haisha-san, Atattemasu! ) manga on Shonen Jump+ in May 2020, and ended it in January 2023. MANGA Plus began publishing the manga in English in August 2020.

Aoki and artist Virginia Nitōhei launched the Shōnin Reijō Agnes: Henkyō ni Tsuihōsareta Akuyaku Reijō wa Shōsai wo Hakkishi Nariagaru (Merchant's Daughter Agnes: The Villainess Banished to a Remote District Rises to Success Through Her Business Skills) manga in Shueisha 's Grand Jump magazine in November 2025. Shueisha shipped the second compiled book volume on September 17.

Aoki launched the Safe & Sound in the Arms of an Elite Knight ( Doinaka no Hakugai Reijō wa Ōto Elite Kishi ni Dekiai Sareru ) light novel series on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in June 2022. Drecom started publishing the novels with illustrations by Minori Aritani in December 2022, and the series ended in its third volume in November 2023. J-Novel Club publishes both the original novel and Yuyu Kouhara 's manga adaptation in English.

title: 3 Shonen Jump Anime That Need Their Own Remake Like Dragon Ball Super
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season is finally here with all the anticipated anime of the quarter, including the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus anime . While fans still have to wait for the main story’s continuation in the Galactic Patrol Saga, Toei Animation first released the remake TV series this month. The anime returned for the first time in eight years, which is why even if it’s a remake, the hype is greater than ever. Not to mention that is fixing the biggest issues with the original anime adaptations, including the animation quality and the pacing. The remake aims to follow the original story written by Akira Toriyama, the original manga creator, while also focusing on better visuals and fight choreography.

A few episodes have already been out, and it’s obvious the new version is much more vibrant and stunning, with better fight choreography as well. However, the remake isn’t just going to improve the quality of the already existing animation clips, but aims to be a full reconstruction of the story with much better pacing. While the title is Dragon Ball Super: Beerus , the anime will cover the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F, and Universe 6 arcs during its run. Although Dragon Ball Super managed to release a remake thanks to its popularity, these three anime also deserve the same treatment.

3) Yu Yu Hakusho

The anime premiered in 1992, three decades ago, and even now, not many series can keep viewers hooked as it did. A huge reason behind its massive success is how it killed off its protagonist at the beginning of the story, after which the story took one unexpected turn after another. The original anime was a massive success, and that’s exactly why it deserves a remake with better pacing and polished visuals. Not to mention that the 1990s animation style isn’t used anymore, which is why it’s increasingly difficult for this series to attract new fans. Not only that, but Yoshihiro Togashi had to rush the Three Kings arc in the manga due to his health issues. It had the potential to be greater than what it already was. An anime reboot might also allow the studio an opportunity to expand the arc into what Togashi initially envisioned.

2) D.Gray-man

There’s no denying that at this point, the anime would do better as a remake rather than releasing a sequel since the earlier chapters weren’t always adapted perfectly. Not to mention that since Hallow was a massive flop, the chances of a sequel being released are slim. The anime’s return in 2016 was highly anticipated, but it failed to capture the gritty details and the true essence of the story that actually made it special. While Hallow was definitely one of the worst Shonen Jump adaptations , the original anime wasn’t exceptional either. Since it followed a weekly schedule, it suffered from slow pacing and even filler scenes or episodes. Even so, the biggest reason why the anime needs a remake is just so it can perfectly capture the tone of the story. The manga is a lot darker than the anime series portrayed it to be, which only got more intense as the story continued.

1) Naruto

This might be a bit of a controversial take, but Naruto needs a remake just as much as Dragon Ball Super . The anime is popular across the globe, but there’s no denying it suffered significantly from inconsistent animation, pacing, and a large number of filler episodes. This beloved classic would probably benefit the most from such an undertaking, since a new era of the anime could streamline it to just featuring the events from Masashi Kishimoto’s original manga series. That means the anime remake would make it a better point of entry for a new generation of fans. This not only applies to the first part of the story, but also Shippuden , which takes place after a brief time skip. While there are already talks of the anime returning with a new movie and special episodes, it might be best to get a special remake version of the main story as well.

Do you agree with our picks, or is there another anime you’d like to see get a remake similar to Dragon Ball Super ? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Bleach’s Final Episode Timeskip Officially Debuts Ichigo & Rukia’s Kids in the Anime
content:
Bleach has now officially come to an end with the release of its final episode after 22 years of the anime, and with it has officially introduced Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki’s respective future children to the anime after a timeskip. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War returned for its final two episodes this month after a surprise hiatus in production, and the penultimate episode of the series brought the long fight against Yhwach to its end as the villain was defeated across all three realms at the same time.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has now come to an end with the launch of the anime’s final episode ever , and with it has revealed a timeskip that takes place ten years after the end of the fight against Yhwach. Adapting the final chapters from Tite Kubo’s original Bleach manga, the anime also fully introduces Kazui Kurosaki and Ichika Abarai to the series as the future children of Ichigo and Rukia (who go on to have their own families), respectively.

Bleach Introduces Kazui and Ichika With the Anime’s Final Episode Timeskip

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 50 is titled “Death & Strawberry ,” and it takes place ten years after the fight against Yhwach. All three realms are now at peace, and everyone has gone on to live their lives. Rukia has been named as the new Captain of Squad 13, and Renji is her Lieutenant. It’s also revealed that the two of them have since entered a romantic relationship, and have had a daughter named Ichika, who has since become a Soul Reaper Cadet. As for Ichigo, he’s had a peaceful future as well as he took over his dad’s clinic in the future together with his own family.

Ichigo and Orihime have since gotten married , and the two of them have had a son named Kazui. Much like his parents, Kazui has a strong affinity to see ghosts but might be inherently stronger than the both of them combined. The episode sees him quickly dealing with the final remnants of Yhwach’s lingering power in an instant (without even really knowing what was going on), and is even a Soul Reaper himself. This even takes Ichika by surprise as Kazui is able to freely summon his own power at will as the final episode comes to an end.

What’s Next for Kazui and Ichika in Bleach ‘s Future?

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War ‘s final episode introduces Azusa Tachibana as the voice of Kazui Kurosaki, and Ayaka Ohashi as the voice of Ichika Abarai. While this is the final episode of the anime after 22 long years, this isn’t the end of Bleach’ s story. Series creator Tite Kubo actually returned to the series a few years ago with a special one-shot to celebrate the manga’s anniversary, and with it picked up from the events of the final episode with the start of a whole new arc with new threats and more .

If the anime’s production team decides to return for more episodes of the Bleach anime in the future, this one-shot release gives them fertile ground to explore. As Kazui and Ichika are aged up a little more with this story, it seems like Kazui’s power would put him at the center of all the new events. Until this story continues, fans will be left wondering what’s next for Bleach in the future . What do you think of Kazui and Ichika’s debut in Bleach’ s final episode? Let us know all of your thoughts in the comments!

title: EAT-MAN The Over Order New Anime Gets Spinoff Manga Series
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for EAT-MAN The Over Order , the new anime project for Akihito Yoshitomi 's Eat-Man manga, announced on Monday that Yoshitomi will launch a spinoff manga adaptation of the upcoming anime, titled Desert-Dessert From EAT-MAN The Over Order . The manga will launch in the January 2027 issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine on November 26.

Masashi Ebara returns from the two previous anime adaptations as protagonist Bolt Crank.

Yoshitomi drew his original Eat-Man manga from 1996 to 2002. Viz Media published part of the original manga in North America. The story follows Bolt Crank, a man who can eat anything and reproduce it in his right hand. The original manga received anime adaptations in 1997 and 1998. Bandai Entertainment released Eat-Man '98 on DVD with an English dub , and Discotek Media released both anime on subtitle-only DVD. Crunchyroll began streaming both anime in 2019.

Yoshitomi launched the Eat-Man The Main Dish manga in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in May 2014. The six-volume manga ended serialization in 2019.

ADV Manga published Yoshitomi's Ray manga , while Section23 Films released the Ray television anime as well as the Blue Drop anime inspired by Yoshitomi's manga of the same name. Yoshitomi also drew Cyborg 009 Vs. Devilman : Breakdown, the manga adaptation of the Cyborg 009 Vs. Devilman crossover anime. The one compiled volume shipped in April 2016.

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Is Returning With Exciting New Manga This Month
content:
Ikuo Hachiya will be returning to Shonen Jump with a brand new manga after the cancellation of Ice-Head Gill . Launched in 1968, Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump eventually became the best-selling manga magazine of all time thanks to the success of several iconic series, including Dragon Ball , One Piece , Naruto , and many more. However, the number of successful series in the magazine is significantly less compared to the underrated manga or even stories that were axed for several reasons. Ice-Head Gill is one such series that failed to gain recognition from readers and critics alike. The manga debuted in June 2023 in Weekly Shonen Jump and was cancelled in November of the same year with its 20th chapter.

While the manga failed to capture the readers’ eye, Hachiya has been working on new stories ever since, and he returned with a one-shot in January this year . Titled Showmanship , the previous one-shot focused on a high school student who also works as a manga artist. However, after an unexpected incident, his classmate demanded advice on her showmanship for her dance performance, which completely changed his life trajectory. This month, however, Hachiya went down the fantasy route again with his new one-shot titled Yokai Matchmaking Agency .

Ice-Head Gill Creator Returns With Another Unique One-Shot in October 2026

The new story from the creator takes place in a world where marriage between humans and yokai is possible. Jinjin, who also happens to be a poverty god, works as a matchmaker at a graveyard matchmaking agency. However, his life turns upside down when a middle school girl comes to his doorstep to seek his help. Following the cancellation of Ice-Head Gill , Hachiya went on a hiatus for a bit, but he bounced back in 2026 with new releases. While there hasn’t been any information regarding his new serialization yet , these one-shots prove that the creator is more than ready to return with a brand new series.

Shonen Jump often releases one-shot manga in the magazine and on digital platforms, which benefits not only the platform but also the creators. Releasing one-shots is common in Shonen Jump to test a creator’s storytelling skills, help them build a portfolio, and even attract editors. In case their work receives a good reception, there’s also a chance of extending the story with a proper serialized manga, although that’s not always the case. Regardless, the creator’s return is an exciting update, as it all but confirms we might keep seeing more works from him in the future.

Yokai Matchmaking Agency Deserves a Longer Run

In only 51 pages, the one-shot introduces a completely new world where humans and yokai getting married is a common occurrence. While Jinjin is a god in name only, he is not exactly popular among humans or Yokai. He finds small comfort in his job, but that’s not enough to rid him of his loneliness. However, things changed when a middle school girl seeks his help. The manga does a great job of setting up the premise and introducing the main characters within limited pages. While there’s no guarantee that the one-shot will ever get turned into a series, there’s no denying it really does have the potential to be something better than Hachiya’s first serialized manga. Ice-Head Gill and all of Hachiya’s one-shots are available to read on the official app of Manga Plus.

Have you read Yokai Matchmaking Agency yet? If so, would you want to see more of Jinjin and Tsuyako? Let us know in the comments below!

However, things changed when a middle school girl seeks his help. The manga does a great job of setting up the premise and introducing the main characters within limited pages. While there’s no guarantee that the one-shot will ever get turned into a series, there’s no denying it really does have the potential to be something better than Hachiya’s first serialized manga. Ice-Head Gill and all of Hachiya’s one-shots are available to read on the official app of Manga Plus.
Have you read Yokai Matchmaking Agency yet? If so, would you want to see more of Jinjin and Tsuyako? Let us know in the comments below!

title: Manga Mavericks Books Licenses Gago Hunters Manga
content:
Manga Mavericks Books , the publishing division of the Manga Mavericks website and podcast, announced on Monday during its online event that it has licensed Sho Yonoko's Gago Hunters: Greetings from Amatsumizu City's Gago Suppression Squad ( Amatsumizu-shi "Gago" Bokumetsu Dayori: Gagohan ) manga. The company will release the manga physically and digitally in July 2027.

The company describes the story:

Greetings from Amatsumizu City! Come for the sights, stay for the…Gago? At first glance, Amatsumizu is a normal-looking town, but mysterious creatures known as the Gago outnumber the people who call the city home. The mayor calls in a crack-team of Gago busters to deal with the supernatural menace – except the team doesn't exist yet! The mayor's on a tight budget, leaving him no choice but to volun-tell a team of ordinary citizens to take on the job. Hair stylist Umeko, cashier Mii, high school student Hiromi, and Umeko's apprentice Yuuri become the Gago Hunters against their will. It sounds like an easy score for the supernatural, but each girl has something…off about them. The Gago had better relocate fast, before they're hunted down by the real monsters of Amatsumizu!

The manga debuted in September 2023 on HERO'S Web. The sixth compiled book volume shipped in Japan on July 6.

Manga Mavericks Books also unveiled a variant cover for its upcoming February 2027 release of Taiyo Matsumoto 's Brothers of Japan ( Nihon no Kyoudai ) manga. The variant cover will be exclusive to the company's online store.

The Manga Mavericks website and podcast established the Manga Mavericks Books publishing division in April 2025 to license, localize, and distribute works worldwide from indie creators in Japan.

title: Dragon Ball Needs to Use Its Coolest Saiyan Form Much More Often
content:
The most hyped transformation in Dragon Ball history is rarely used, so there should be a resurgence of Super Saiyan 3 in the future. Goku shattered everyone’s minds by taking more than five minutes of screen time to grow his hair longer, lose his eyebrows and make electricity surround him. But in all seriousness, this form was the first that looked and felt dramatically different than when Super Saiyan was first introduced. The severity of the situation called for something even greater than already-reached forms.

Vegeta went to Super Saiyan 2 and had the extra Majin boost but couldn’t defeat Buu. He even sacrificed himself, thinking if he unleashed all his power that would make the difference. It did not, and the sacrifice was for nothing. Goku knew the kind of enemy he would be facing and took his power even further. The major drawback of this form is that it costs too much energy to stay in it for long. However, depending on the Saiyan, it’s proved just as formidable as higher forms.

Super Saiyan 3 Has Been Making A Comeback Recently

Dragon Ball Daima gave Vegeta his long-awaited Super Saiyan 3 transformation . He moved up the power ladder, despite being changed into a kid by King Gomah. He gets some revenge on Gomah when he thoroughly beats him up. Eventually, the energy drains him, and he’s forced to tag in Goku. However, his contributions to help defeat Gomah, and the sheer dominance of his Super Saiyan 3 form is a fun watch.

The use of the form in Dragon Ball Daima finished off a long-awaited move for Vegeta. Even though Super Saiyan 3 was more than 30 years past its debut , this was a big deal in the plot. How can a form be so important if its so old? This answers the question on why it should come back. Similar to the first Super Saiyan level, the awe of the moment and ensuing power jump are too much to just roll past. Goku became Super Saiyan 3 so late in Dragon Ball Z that there wasn’t much time to use it, and it was unstable. By the time Dragon Ball GT and Dragon Ball Super came out, it had become old news despite having little screen time. This is why it’s making a comeback in newer media.

Super Dragon Ball Heroes made Super Saiyan 3 a mainstay in its limited episodes. The Evil Saiyan Cumber appears to be in Super Saiyan 3 when he takes on the Golden Great Ape form and later battles non-canon Broly in the actual form later. The use of the transformation gave it more credibility. The form is joked about regularly otherwise because, despite its massive increase in strength, it’s too volatile and too slow to keep up with the newer Super Saiyan forms.

Super Saiyan 3 Changed The Game

Although its not been used much, the form has a cool moment outside of its debut that deserve mention. Gotenks’ ascension to the form was the first time Trunks and Goten proved that they were capable of equaling their fathers even if it was with the help of fusion. Gohan had proven himself a worthy warrior, but to see the kids dominate Evil Buu for a bit was a different animal.

In totality, it’s only been used with a few characters in the canon series and only a handful of times in the non-canon releases with the Dragon Ball Xenoverse characters and Cumber. Do you think that Super Saiyan 3 should continue to see an uptick in upcoming Dragon Ball titles? Let us know in the comments.

title: Marco Kohinata's Akari Manga Wins French Prix Ouest-France Award
content:
French comic festival Quai des Bulles awarded the French-language version of Marco Kohinata 's Akari manga the Prix Ouest-France award as part of its event this year. The story also won the ABCD Asia Award 2026 in July.

A committee comprised of festival organizers and reporters from the country's most circulated daily newspaper, Ouest-France , selected the manga through a vote.

This marks the first time a Japanese title has won the award.

The Quai des Bulles comic festival ran from October 9-11 in Saint-Malo, France.

Glacier Bay Books publishes the title in English and describes the story:

A quietly beautiful standalone story about mistaken identity, found family, and the profound power of art. Marco Kohinata 's warm, softly textured lines and shading subtly evoke the color and shape, the fullness and complexity of human emotion.

Hero's Inc. released the one-volume manga in Japan in 2022.

The Toronto Comic Arts Festival (TCAF) hosted Kohinata as a guest at this year's event from June 6-7.

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Continues to Break Records Weeks After Its Streaming Debut
content:
While the animation studio hasn’t shared any updates on the second installment of the Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle trilogy, the first movie is still a major hit. The movie hit Japanese theatres in July last year and became a massive hit before its international premiere in September 2025. After a record-breaking run, the anime hit the streaming platforms a year later. The anime first began streaming on Crunchyroll before Netflix added it to its library on September 28th, 2026. It’s been a month since the movie has been available to fans in the U.S., but its popularity hasn’t died down yet.

According to Netflix Tudum , the first installment of the Infinity Castle trilogy has been in the top 10 rankings of the global charts in the non-English movies category. During the first week since its debut, the movie gathered a staggering 6.4 million views, ranking on top of the charts. It was a huge leap from the second-ranked movie, titled What a Father, which gathered 2 million views. In the second week, the movie ranked fourth with over 2 million views. Surprisingly enough, it also made it to the list again with 1.2 million views, ranking in seventh place. The view count for the fourth week hasn’t been revealed yet, but even if there has been a steady decline each week, the fact that the movie has managed to stay in the top 10 even after weeks is astounding.

Demon Slayer Has an Exciting Update for Fans Waiting for Infinity Castle Part 2

Even though it’s been over a year since the movie was released, Ufotable hasn’t shared any updates on what to expect next. However, the wait is almost over since this year’s Jump Festa is right around the corner, where Demon Slayer will hold a panel on the Super Stage . Jump Festa 2027 will be held on December 19th and 20th this year, where fans can expect exciting updates on the anime and manga of their favorite Shonen Jump series. It’s already been confirmed that Demon Slayer will be at the center of attention on the biggest stage of the event, which is why we can expect at least a few updates regarding the anime’s future. With the manga already over and no hopes for a sequel, the anime is the only thing fans are waiting for. There are also rumors circulating around that the second installment will be released next year, but we will know for sure after an official announcement during the convention.

What to Expect from Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 2

The first movie only covered the initial phase of the Infinity Castle Arc, but a majority of the battles will be adapted in the next installments. Doma, the Upper Rank Two, is still standing strong even after Shinobu used poison on him. The movie ends on a major cliffhanger as it sets up the upcoming battles in the arc while Nakime continues to shift the layout of the Infinity Castle to confuse the Demon Slayers. The Infinity Castle is the longest arc in the story, with several intense battles often leading to tragic endings. The situation will turn from bad to worse from here on out since Kokushibo has yet to jump into action. The second part of the trilogy will also focus on the fight against the Upper Moons since there’s still a while before Muzan enters the battlefield.

Are you excited for the thrilling battles in the second installment of the Infinity Castle trilogy? Let us know in the comments which manga moments you’re most looking forward to seeing in the anime!
